Chapter 633 - 633 Changing Rooms; Noisy!

633 Changing Rooms; Noisy!

The Imperial Hotel had been very famous since a thousand years ago.

Large corporations, families, and even officials… All of them would choose to hold banquets and entertain guests at the Imperial Hotel.

Every head of the Wang family was the general manager of the Imperial Hotel.

It was also because of this that the Wang family was able to accumulate wealth, and it also allowed them to obtain many connections and possess an extremely high status.

Wang You, the current head of the Wang family, had been groomed by the family since he was young. His temper, personality, and ability far exceeded ordinary people.

In the past, no matter what he dealt with, he was always as calm as water and easily resolved every problem.

However…

Today, he seemed very anxious.

After he put down his phone, he did not care about the custom-made exotic beast leather shoes that cost 100,000 World Coins on his feet. He jogged all the way to the small garden.

The servants on the way bowed and greeted him.

However, Wang You did not even have the time to respond.

In the small garden, an old man wearing a Tang suit named Wang Qianjin frowned slightly and said, “Wang You, didn’t I teach you this before? As the head of the family, the first thing you have to do is to remain calm!”

Wang You took a deep breath before calming himself down.

After a while, he said, “Yes, Dad.”

“What happened?” Wang Qianjin asked lightly.

“Mr. Lin is here!” Wang You said.

Wang Qianjin was stunned for a moment and said, “Mr. Lin?”

“Mr. Lin Fan,” Wang You said again.

“What? Are you talking about Mr. Lin Fan from 1,000 years ago? Boss Lin?” Wang Qianjin’s pupils constricted slightly as he said excitedly.

“Yes.” Wang You continued, “It’s a message from the mysterious account left behind by our ancestor.”

“Mr. Lin is back, Mr. Lin is back!” Wang Qianjin shouted excitedly again. “Where is Mr. Lin now?”

“He’s on the 365th floor of the Imperial Hotel,” Wang You said.

“Good, good, good!” Wang Qianjin shouted. “Quickly gather all the direct descendants of the Wang family. Also, come with me to see the old master, and then we’ll meet Mr. Lin together!”

Then, the entire Wang family became noisy.

Wang Qianjin, who had been calm and indifferent just now, was in a frenzy.

The old man and the middle-aged man were like children as they continued to advance in the Wang family manor like a competition.

After a while, the two of them arrived in front of a green bamboo forest.

A white-haired Wang Zhihai was practicing tai chi in the bamboo forest.

After he heard what Wang Qianjin and Wang You said, a rare flush gradually appeared on his originally thin old face.

“Get ready to open Hibernation Chamber 0,” Wang Zhihai said.

Wang Qianjin and Wang You turned solemn.

They knew very well what was inside Hibernation Chamber 0.

“Now, let’s go and meet Mr. Lin.”

“Yes,” Wang Qianjin and Wang You said in unison.

…

Meanwhile, at the Imperial Hotel.

Xia Xue was facing the camera and interacting with the audience in the live broadcast room.

“Where else do you want to see?

“Later, I’ll taste the delicacies of the Imperial Hotel and tell everyone how they taste.”

…

At this moment, the door of the private room was suddenly pushed open.

Then, Fang Wenjie and the gorgeous woman walked in.

The gorgeous woman’s eyes lit up when she saw the gorgeous decorations in the private room and the fairy-like clouds outside the French window.

“Brother Wenjie, this private room is so beautiful,” she said coquettishly. “If I eat here, my appetite will definitely be very good.”

As she spoke, she started rubbing against Fang Wenjie’s body again.

“Alright, then we’ll eat here.” Fang Wenjie smiled.

Then, he said to Lin Fan, “Bro, I’ll take out twice the money to buy the Deep Sea Golden Gall and Giant Scorpion that you ordered. Also, I’ll take out another 100,000 World Coins to get your private room. How about that?”

Fang Wenjie’s tone did not contain a trace of inquiry or discussion at all.

He said his words like he was giving out an order.

He was high and mighty, looking down on everything!

Since Xia Xue walked into the Imperial Hotel, the number of people in her live broadcast room had been rising.

At this moment, it had already reached 400,000 people.

After hearing Fang Wenjie’s words, the entire live broadcast room was flooded with comments.

Big Ka: [F*ck, this person is so arrogant!]

Chong Yang: [But he has the capital to be arrogant! If I’m not mistaken, he should be the Fang family’s young master, Fang Wenjie.]

Hanada Cuo: [Fang family? The Fang family of Dafang Group?]

Little Painter: [That’s right! It’s the Dafang Group! Last time, I even saw some gossip about him online. Is the person beside him Xiao Xiaoyu? She has more than 20 million fans!]

Happy Family: [I really don’t want Xia Xue to give the private room to Fang Wenjie, but he’s offering 100,000 World Coins, after all. Besides, the Fang family is so scary… Sigh.]

Fool: [Xia Xue should not force herself considering she’s up against such a vicious young master.]

…

Everyone understood that in front of absolute power, one had to lower one’s head.

Xia Xue had never encountered such a situation, and she could not help but be nervous and flustered.

Lin Fan gently patted Xia Xue’s shoulder and gave her a reassuring look.

Then, he slowly opened his mouth and spat out two words.

“Get out!”

He did not seem to have used too much strength.

However, his voice reverberated in the private room.

Fang Wenjie’s face instantly turned ugly.

“What did you say?”

“Scram!” Lin Fan said again.

His voice was like thunder, causing Fang Wenjie and the gorgeous woman’s ears to buzz.

Instantly, Fang Wenjie’s face sank.

No one had ever dared to speak to him like this.

He was completely enraged!

“Brat, how dare you?!”

Lin Fan raised his brows and said solemnly, “How noisy!”

As soon as he finished speaking, he waved his hand casually.

Fang Wenjie’s entire body seemed to have been hit by a car. He flew out and smashed into the wall outside, unable to get up again.

“Ah!” The gorgeous woman was so frightened that she screamed loudly.

Then, she hurriedly ran to Fang Wenjie’s side and said, “Brother Wenjia, are you okay?”

At this moment, hurried footsteps sounded in the corridor.

The waiter seemed to have heard the abnormality in the private room and ran over in a hurry.

He first used a very apologetic tone and said, “Mr. Lin, I’m sorry for disturbing your meal.”

Then, the waiter looked at Fang Wenjie, who was lying on the ground and unable to get up. He could not help but say in surprise, “Young Master Fang?”

The Fang family had great power, and Fang Wenjie was a regular customer of the Imperial Hotel. The waiter obviously knew him.

“You came just in time. This kid actually dared to attack me. Hurry up! Hurry up and get someone to arrest him!” Fang Wenjie used all his strength to scream hysterically.
